limitations: Durations labelled monotonic use the observer/runner performance clock; UTC spans are reported separately. A gap over two seconds flags clock or suspend discontinuity with unknown cause, not experienced elapsed wall-clock duration.
Process counters include the converter and time/caffeinate wrappers; independent resource monitors are excluded. Whole-command CPU counters are not exact per-stage counters.

Process inventory is limited to named converter/build/engine executables. Captured competing CPU increases are lower bounds; OS percent-CPU uses an unknown averaging window. UTC sampling gaps prevent reconstructing omitted activity.
GPU counters are global driver observations with an unknown averaging window, not per-process GPU usage or evidence of saturation.

Iostat is global and includes other processes; no queue, latency or device-utilization metric establishes storage saturation. Averages describe observed rows without weighting a UTC clock discontinuity.
Disk free space includes unrelated volume writes. Logical output sizes and unique-inode bytes do not measure APFS physical space use.
CPU cold used the earlier binary before native SHA acceleration; subsequent metadata legs use the newer binary. These loaded-host release durations do not isolate a causal GPU speedup.
Acceptance audits run after the measured converter command. Failed original helper evidence remains intact; recovered audit outcomes are recorded separately.

Named inventory records observed executables, including compiled tests, dormant processes and short commands. It does not mean every inventoried process was actively competing throughout a leg; per-PID captured CPU increases distinguish sampled activity.
Matched extraction uses 2048 real entries rewritten into an uncompressed fixture; no selection benefit is measured.
Matched atlas timings exclude loading, fingerprints, device initialization, quality checks and publication.
Matched quick-profile kernels predate hardware SHA and final failure-cleanup patches; successful compression recipes are unchanged.
Release runs overlap unrelated work. CPU cold predates hardware SHA. No isolated end-to-end GPU speedup is established.
Global GPU and disk counters are not per-process saturation measurements.
converted and cache_hits combine archive extraction entries and ordinary asset items; they are not unique runtime-file counts.
Stack sample fractions describe local thread-wall observations, not additive whole-conversion phase shares.
The source reference lacks authored origins in 38 worlds with 1105 LAND cells; all 14 LAND worlds with origins compile.
Metadata extraction omits one unchanged archive without a matching source-package plugin; full extraction omits no archives.
Windows file flushes are implemented; directory durability is a documented platform limitation.
Archive source inodes must remain immutable while mapped; custom shared cache roots lack a cross-output writer lock.
